'''Mononobe Shrine''' (物部神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} derived from the {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|qid=Q41493|lt=Ancient|1=Ancient history}}{{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}’s {{ill|Mononobe clan|en|Mononobe clan|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe clan|1=Mononobe clan}}. Shrines bearing this name are distributed over a wide area from {{ill|Eastern Japan|ja|東日本|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eastern Japan}} to {{ill|Western Japan|ja|西日本|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Western Japan|1=Western Japan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1063946}}. Many of them enshrine as their main deities either {{ill|Umashimaji|ja|ウマシマジ|lt=Umasimaji|lt_ja=宇麻志摩遅命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Umashimaji}}, the first of the Mononobe clan, or {{ill|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|lt=Nigihayahi|lt_ja=饒速日命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nigihayahi}}, the ancestral deity.
